_comment: Editorial content for GEMMEL. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached: no licence-cleared photograph of this company's own facility exists on the open licence sources, and a generic industry photo would imply it is theirs.
description: Mughal Energy Limited was incorporated in 2012 as an unquoted public limited company to generate, purchase, import, transform, convert, distribute and supply electricity and other forms of energy and associated products or services. Its registered office is at 31-A Shadman-I, Lahore, and it is a subsidiary of Mughal Iron & Steel Industries Limited.
